temporal_contract.workbook_year: Container year, not the observation date; every discovered monthly sheet must use this year.
temporal_contract.source_month: Each published crossing is assigned to its exact monthly worksheet.

suppression_semantics.rule: INE publishes only origin-destination crossings with more than 30 tourists.
suppression_semantics.absent_is_not_zero: Origins may be outside the source universe, including same-province travel; within the covered universe absent rows may be suppressed and are never materialised as zero or an other-origins residual.

interpretation_ceiling: Source-reported resident tourists from published Spanish origin municipalities travelling to Madrid municipality from another province in a source month. Same-province travel is outside the source universe. It is descriptive context, not a complete distribution of domestic tourism, a share of all domestic tourists, a market ranking, causal evidence, forecast or any barrio, district or Lens-circle measure.

source_universe.trip_condition: Travel to a province different from the province of residence
